from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,re
base=Path("benchmark_tools/results")
generation=json.loads((base/"publication_conditional_fas_generation_20261010_v1.json").read_text())
current=base/"publication_conditional_fas_manuscript_20261010_v1.md"
data=current.read_bytes()
parent=Path(generation["inputs"]["parent"]["path"]).read_bytes()
restored=data
for section in generation["inserted_sections"]:
 piece=section.encode()
 assert restored.count(piece)==1
 restored=restored.replace(piece,b"",1)
assert restored==parent
assert len(parent)==103788 and hashlib.sha256(parent).hexdigest()=="43daded442eab987cfe29863f8c661d82cdfbc4d55443d4e7896300e2917e45b"
for ref in list(generation["inputs"].values())+[generation["source"],generation["manuscript"]]:
 raw=Path(ref["path"]).read_bytes()
 assert len(raw)==ref["bytes"] and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==ref["sha256"]
report=json.loads(Path(generation["inputs"]["report"]["path"]).read_text())
section=generation["inserted_sections"][0]; rows=[line for line in section.splitlines() if line.startswith("| ")][2:]
assert len(rows)==8
for line,row in zip(rows,report["methods"]):
 fields=[x.strip() for x in line.split("|")[1:-1]]
 assert fields[0]==row["method"] and float(fields[1])==round(row["observed_native_mean"],9)
 assert fields[2]=="[%.9f, %.9f]" % tuple(row["interval"]["expected_native_mean_bounds"])
for text in generation["inserted_sections"]:
 for target in re.findall(r"\]\(([^)]+)\)",text): assert (current.parent/target).resolve().exists()
normalized=re.sub(r"\s+"," ",section)
assert "not the later four-cell" in normalized and "not biological error bars centered on Z" in normalized
assert "Proteinortho exceeds both" in normalized and "earlier negative F1 comparisons remain unchanged" in normalized
assert "Unknown" not in normalized or "theta point value" in normalized
assert "newer native factorial" in re.sub(r"\s+"," ",generation["inserted_sections"][1])
assert generation["parent_unchanged_except_insertions"] is True and generation["conditional_design_ranges_reported"] is True
for key in ("new_inference_or_scoring","unconditional_historical_interval_admission","biological_generalization_intervals","publication_ready","manuscript_rendered","visual_reviewed"): assert generation[key] is False
print(json.dumps(dict(status="scoped_conditional_fas_manuscript_readback_passed",parent_bytes=len(parent),manuscript_bytes=len(data),manuscript_sha256=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),insertions=2,table_rows=8,new_links=4,parent_restored_byte_exact=True,manuscript_rendered=False),sort_keys=True))
'
